title: sorla-db
tagline: A document database for the browser and Node: MongoDB queries, schema validation, live queries for React, Vue, Svelte and Angular, and loading over Server-Sent Events or WebSocket.

highlights.title: MongoDB queries you already know
highlights.text: find, $in, $regex, $or, updateOne, $set, $push, upsert, bulkWrite: shareable with your backend as plain JSON.

highlights.title: Safe by default
highlights.text: Copies in, copies out; batches validated before anything is written; stored documents never change in place.

highlights.title: Fast
highlights.text: An _id index, cursors that copy only what you read, updates that copy only what changed. 100 000 documents are comfortable.

highlights.title: Schema validation
highlights.text: A JSON Schema subset with defaults and readable errors, or a function. Every problem reported at once.

highlights.title: Live queries
highlights.text: watch() keeps a result current, and becomes a React hook, a Vue ref, a Svelte store or an Angular signal.

highlights.title: Server sync
highlights.text: Load a million rows in blocks over Server-Sent Events, or page and receive live changes over a WebSocket.

highlights.title: Forms in one line
highlights.text: bindForm turns an HTML form into an insert or edit form, with conversion and errors from the schema.

highlights.title: No dependencies, 54 kB
highlights.text: Browser bundle, CommonJS and ES modules, TypeScript types, Node 18+.

highlights.title: Tested
highlights.text: 227 tests, including 500 random nested queries checked against a reference implementation.
